snippet.title: Ghost Hunting Journal | Extended Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Ghost Hunting Journal is an anime-style adventure with an otaku twist on the paranormal. Play as two unconventional Spirit Agents and investigate urban legends, lingering ghosts, and supernatural mysteries in this story-driven anime adventure. Switch between partners, explore the city, and uncover cases that blend horror, humor, and heart.

 Wishlist us on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3646950/Ghost_Hunting_Journal/

 Our demo will be updated on April 10. 

Stay tuned!
Discord: https://discord.gg/WPCmhTTnz8
X: https://x.com/SpicyLao
